scenicChapters.title: Building remains southwest of Saalburg → Fort Schrenzer
scenicChapters.narrative: 27 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: German Fairy Tale Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 64 km this is German Fairy Tale Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

places-building-remains-southwest-of-saa.story: 232 km from Wehrheim to Wehrheim, about 4 h of riding. The stops in between: Fort Schrenzer, Watchtowers WP 4/72 to 4/73, Fort site and civil settlement of Seligens and back through Watchtowers WP 4/72 to 4/73. The line favours views over speed.
